const src = "/workspace/repos/Ludock-go-rewrite/packages/backend/src";
process.env.LUDOCK_DB_PATH = "/tmp/ludock-fixture-gen/out/ludock.db";
const database = await import(`${src}/database.ts`);
const password = await import(`${src}/password.ts`);
const identity = await import(`${src}/identity.ts`);
const authorization = await import(`${src}/authorization.ts`);
const db = database.getDatabase();
const adminHash = await password.hashPassword("fixture-admin-password-1");
const viewerHash = await password.hashPassword("fixture-viewer-password-1");
database.createUser({ id: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", username: "Admin", passwordHash: adminHash, role: "admin", disabled: false, createdAt: 1700000000000 });
database.createUser({ id: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", username: "viewer", passwordHash: viewerHash, role: "viewer", disabled: false, createdAt: 1700000000001 });
const observations = [
  { containerId: "a".repeat(64), name: "/mc", displayName: "Minecraft", gameType: "minecraft",
    compose: { project: "games stack", service: "mc/1", containerNumber: "1" },
    mounts: [
      { type: "bind", source: "/srv/mc//data/", destination: "/data/", writable: true },
      { type: "volume", source: "/var/lib/docker/volumes/x/_data", name: "Zeta", destination: "/b", writable: true },
      { type: "bind", source: "/srv/ro", destination: "/ro", writable: false },
      { type: "bind", source: "/srv/Upper", destination: "/a", writable: true },
      { type: "bind", source: "/srv/_under", destination: "/a", writable: true },
    ],
    gameConfiguration: { "env:RCON_PASSWORD": "pw<&> é", "ludock.console.port": "25575", "Env:B": "x", "env:a": "y", "env:_z": "z", "env:1": "1", "env:é": "e" } },
  { containerId: "b".repeat(64), name: "/valheim", displayName: "Valheim", gameType: "valheim", mounts: [] },
];
identity.reconcileServers(observations, { now: 1700000001000 });
const servers = identity.listLogicalServers();
const mc = servers.find((s) => s.displayName === "Minecraft");
authorization.setUserServerGrants("22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  [{ serverId: mc.id, capabilities: ["server.view", "logs.read"] }],
  { id: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", username: "Admin", role: "admin" });
database.writeAuditLog({ userId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", action: "fixture.created", targetType: "server", targetId: mc.id, details: { note: "<fixture>" } });
db.query("INSERT INTO schedules(id,server_id,owner_id,input_json,binding_revision,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)")
  .run("33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", mc.id, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    JSON.stringify({ kind: "recurring", action: "restart", enabled: true, time: "04:00", days: [1, 3], timezone: "Europe/Berlin" }), 1, 1700000002000);
const vectors = {
  adminPassword: "fixture-admin-password-1",
  viewerPassword: "fixture-viewer-password-1",
  servers: servers.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, externalIdentity: s.externalIdentity, bindingFingerprint: s.bindingFingerprint })),
  observations,
  credentialFingerprint: database.keyedCredentialFingerprint("x".repeat(40)),
  composeSourceFingerprint: database.keyedComposeSourceFingerprint("c".repeat(64)),
};
await Bun.write("/tmp/ludock-fixture-gen/out/vectors.json", JSON.stringify(vectors, null, 2));
database.closeDatabase();
